narrationTexts: Now applying the migration to all 12 files.
finalText:

| File |
|---|
| `returnService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `cohort.js`, `couponService.js`, `refund.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`, `sla.js`, `teamService.js`, `session.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `variantAdmin.js` |

`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query` — left untouched, it's marked "Do not edit, replaced wholesale on upgrade."

Next: nothing. Confirm the vendor exception is acceptable, or ask upstream to update legacy-orm.
